notes.title: Cubism - Volume 2 Update
notes.content:
Jump back into Cubism with Volume 2: a free update adding 30 new challenging puzzles in a brand new campaign!

This update helps mark the one year anniversary of the game's release, which launched in September of last year. The addition of new puzzles has been a frequent request, and this update should add another 2/3 hours of new spatial reasoning puzzles to play through.

Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Mod & Replay Update
notes.content:
The first feature update for Cubism is here! 
This update makes it easier to share the game with new players, and takes a first step towards supporting modded custom puzzles.

[previewyoutube=RaTXCZooaLA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]MULTIPLE SAVE FILES[/b]
Want to show Cubism to a friend or family member, but don't want to clear your progress? You can now switch between three different save files, making it easy to share Cubism with others, or for you to revisit the early levels of the game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32421162/3612faccd5b83f466ec0dc9ef8dfcfccc14e5f89.png[/img]

[b]MOD SUPPORT FOR CUSTOM PUZZLES[/b]
You can now add custom puzzles, which will then show up under a new "Custom Puzzles" menu item. Although an in-game level editor is planned for a future update to make puzzle creation easier, this is already a first small step towards enabling community created puzzles!

To learn more about adding custom puzzles and how to create your own, have a look at 
[url=https://github.com/cubismvr/Mods/blob/main/CustomPuzzles] this readme [/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32421162/9173b15332710dd239db31108a9d59f98ae5fb26.png[/img]

[b]OTHER UPDATES[/b]
[list]
    [*]Support for modded custom color themes. ([url=https://github.com/cubismvr/Mods/blob/main/CustomTheme] learn more [/url])
    [*]Made re-calibrating the play area position easier.
    [*]Simplified the 'general' options in the menu
[/list]

notes.title: Cubism Demo Update 0.3
notes.content:
Has it already been over year? Oof - sorry about that.
Between moving countries due to visa issues and working my day job, progress on Cubism hasn’t always been as consistent as I’d like, but I’m happy to say we’re getting closer to the finish line!

My goal is to get Cubism to Early Access on Steam in the next month or so, and fully released by this summer. In the meantime, here’s a big update to the demo with all the improvements from the last year of development. If you own a quest, you can also get [url=https://sdq.st/a-403]this version of the demo via SideQuest[/url]!



Changelog:[list]
[*] [b]Simplified tutorial and controls[/b]
The full game can now be played with just the triggers, making it much easier to pick up and play for people at all skill levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32421162/f7dc9fa5e6168d33acc679e9e249d04f2cb6ad03.gif[/img]

[*] [b]6 puzzles with varying difficulties[/b]
The original demo had 12 puzzles, where the difficulty in later levels varied heavily. This demo is shorter, but is hopefully a better balanced sample of what the full game will be like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32421162/a3c46b39679016ecce890cbbb707b30cd53b3a50.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Night mode[/b]
If the default environment is too bright for your taste, you can now switch to night mode in the options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32421162/e2e1f6081d6223a807194d8732fa0166ce001b6d.gif[/img]

[*] The puzzle-grid can now be grabbed with the triggers.
[*] UI redesign. Menu is now placed in-world underneath the puzzle.
[*] Advanced controls option to enable piece rotation with the joystick/touchpad and piece gathering with the A-button/touchpad.
[*] Support for Knuckles controllers
[*] Improved UI for spectator camera on desktop
[*] Added hover highlights to puzzle pieces.
[*] Pieces can be passed between hands.
[*] Overhauled the progress saving system, addressing some progress-related bugs that would appear after updating the game.
[*] Improved the puzzle data-structure.
[*] Recentering the view in Steam/Oculus puts the puzzle back in front of you.
[/list]

notes.title: Cubism Demo Update 0.2
notes.content:
Hi all!

It's been a while since the last update, but I've been hard at work on completing the full game. A lot of work is going into rebuilding some of Cubism's underlying systems to insure it's maintainability in the future, and to make it easier to support future platforms.  Beyond that, I've spent a lot of time designing puzzles and working on the audio in the game.

This update to v0.2 brings some of this work to the demo:
[list]
    [*] A first pass of adding musical audio to the puzzles: every puzzle piece plays a note when spawned, and all the puzzle pieces together will play a chord when solving a puzzle.
    [*]Added more sound effects throughout the game. (some of these are still placeholders though)
    [*]Added an option for unrestricted rotation of the puzzle. The default still restricts puzzle rotation, since it might be disorienting for some players, but this mode does make it easier to place pieces at the top/bottom of a puzzle. Let me know if you prefer playing like this!
[/list]
        
That's it for now! As always, if you have any feedback or bump into any issues, leave a comment below, tweet at me, or shoot me an email at info@cubism-vr.com.

Happy puzzling!
Thomas

notes.title: Cubism Demo Update 0.13
notes.content:
Hi all! 

This is a small update with mostly bug-fixes and tweaks:
[list]
[*]You can now enable a floorgrid from the options menu, which may increase comfort for some players as you'll feel more grounded.
[*]Widened collides on floating puzzle pieces to make grabbing them easier.
[*]Instead of being always on, the 'boomerang force' on puzzle pieces is now only applied when they're thrown far away, making them fly back. This solves the issue of pieces suddenly jolting towards the controllers.
[*]Fixed a bug where if you opened the menu immediately after finishing a puzzle, the menu would open a second time by itself.
[*]Fixed a bug where the first puzzle appears unsolved after solving it and restarting the game.
[*]Fixed a bug where unlocked puzzles still appear to be locked after clearing progress and solving the first puzzle.
[/list]

That's it for now! As always, if you have any feedback or bump into any issues, feel free to post in the forums or shoot me an email at info@cubism-vr.com.

Happy puzzling! 
Thomas
